# Isaac Yong

> Personal site of Isaac Yong (용이삭, GitHub NaNIsaac), M.S. in physics, Sogang University. Works on X-ray scattering and diffraction and the scientific software around it: XRR inverse problems, coherent and time-resolved diffraction, and experimental data systems.

The site is static (GitHub Pages, Jekyll for the notes). The home page has an interactive 2D wave simulation, a project list, three short sections that each show a real output of the code (dynamical diffraction with TraTT, phase retrieval with QoraPhase, thin-film reflectivity with XRefine; all on simulated data, and labelled so), and links to upstream pull requests.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nanisaac.github.io/): profile, projects, recent notes and upstream pull requests
- [Lab](https://nanisaac.github.io/lab/): ripple tank and Fourier bench; draw an aperture, see its far field, filter the spectrum
- [Tools](https://nanisaac.github.io/tools/): beamline arithmetic: energy and wavelength, Bragg angle, q and d-spacing, beam footprint, transmission
- [Notes](https://nanisaac.github.io/notes/): short notes on X-ray physics and scientific software
- [GitHub stats](https://nanisaac.github.io/stats/): activity, repositories, pull requests, traffic, CI and a to-do list of what needs attention; plain-text version at [summary.md](https://nanisaac.github.io/stats/data/summary.md), index at [llms.txt](https://nanisaac.github.io/stats/llms.txt)
- [How the homepage wave works](https://nanisaac.github.io/notes/2026/10/how-the-hero-wave-works/): the 2D scalar wave model, double slit and detector line behind the hero

## Software

- [xray.ooguy](https://xray.ooguy.com/): offline X-ray and beamline calculators with a beamtime logbook, ES5 for old control-room browsers ([Korean](https://xray.ooguy.com/ko/))
- [QoraFlow](https://github.com/NaNIsaac/QoraFlow): toolkit for time-resolved XFEL pump-probe data, tailored to PAL-XFEL
- [QoraPhase](https://github.com/NaNIsaac/QoraPhase): JAX-native, composable phase-retrieval framework for coherent diffraction imaging (PyPI: qoraphase)
- [QoraDFXM](https://github.com/NaNIsaac/QoraDFXM): dark-field X-ray microscopy image analysis; Python engine, CLI and PySide6 app
- [CXD](https://github.com/NaNIsaac/CXD): coherent X-ray diffraction analysis: SPEC parsing, Timepix frames, q-space regridding
- [ReflectoLearn](https://github.com/NaNIsaac-Research/ReflectoLearn): XRR inverse modeling with a differentiable Abeles simulator and a 1D CNN
- [TraTT](https://github.com/NaNIsaac-Research/TraTT): time-dependent Takagi-Taupin solver for transient acoustic Bragg satellites (PyPI: tratt; KPS 2026 Fall poster)
- [codigest](https://github.com/NaNIsaac/codigest): turns a codebase, diffs and terminal output into LLM-ready context; MCP server for coding agents (PyPI: codigest, MCP: io.github.NaNIsaac/codigest)
- [roi_rectangle](https://github.com/NaNIsaac/roi_rectangle): Lightweight rectangular ROI handling for images (PyPI: roi-rectangle)
- [hanfix](https://github.com/NaNIsaac/hanfix): re-runs a shell command typed with the Korean keyboard layout on, converted back to QWERTY
- [deai](https://github.com/NaNIsaac/deai): removes AI co-author credits from git history without changing code (PyPI: git-deai)
